items.label: Waterproof Thick Material
items.value: Outdoor cushions for patio furniture are made of 300GSM high density polyester fabric with waterproof PU coating, The surface of the fabric is both waterproof, which is light and thick

items.label: Size Selection
items.value: 2 piece set include 1 back pillow and 1 seat bottom. Please measure the size of your furniture before purchase to ensure the cushions fit properly. Our outdoor cushions are available in different sizes, suitable for sofas and couchs

items.label: Excellent Details
items.value: The outdoor seat cushions attached ties, ensure that the cushions are securely attached to your furniture. The outdoor chair cushions feature a hidden zip for easy care

items.label: Comfortable Foam
items.value: The outdoor patio cushions of bottom is made of 4" medium firm high-density foam, providing softness and support. It quickly rebounds and maintains its original thickness even with prolonged use, allowing for relaxation of the buttocks

items.label: Upgrade the Back Cushion Filling
items.value: The patio furniture cushions of back is filled with Shredded Foam for a more comfortable experience. It offers superior waist support and is noticeably thicker than other brands' patio cushions
